Answer one question using only the supplied summary, handoff and source responses. The records describe the complete listed scenario within their stated scope. Do not use tools, files, browsing, other agents or outside knowledge. Do not guess missing results or unavailable report contents.

You may request up to two source records. To request one, respond with only a JSON object: {"action":"read","source":"record-v1"}, replacing the alias with one from the catalog. A source response will be supplied in this conversation. Each request, including an unavailable or repeated record, counts toward the limit. You may answer without retrieval when the supplied information suffices.

When ready, respond with only {"action":"answer","answer":"your concise answer and explanation","evidence":["summary","record-v1"]}. List only the supplied summary/handoff or source aliases you actually used; omit unused entries. Keep each response under 150 words where possible.

Answer every part of the question. For an affirmative feasibility or eligibility answer, give a witnessing build, instant or task interval. For held-out validation, state the numbers of observed passes, observed failures and untested cases, and identify a failed or untested case. For a current-evidence question, identify the relevant report version; distinguish the latest listed report from evidence you can actually inspect, and state any uncertainty caused by unavailable contents. Judge only the listed builds, resources, policies and reports. Do not extend a scoped observation into a broader assurance.

SUMMARY
The day1 report found no failures in tested cases.

HANDOFF

Scope and omissions: A day2 report exists; its contents and current availability are not carried here.
Relevant dated source: record-v1, day1; record-v2, day2.
Recovery trigger: Retrieve the latest report before judging the current state; retain uncertainty if it is unavailable.

SOURCE CATALOG
record-v1 — day1
record-v2 — day2

QUESTION
